description: A troublemaking child in the Village Hidden in the Leaves who struggles to graduate from Ninja Academy and aims to become the next Hokage.

roles_and_vocations.note: VIZ directly says Naruto is struggling to graduate from Ninja Academy; it does not state his rank, deployment, or professional status.

affiliations.note: The VIZ synopsis places Naruto in the village; no clan, team, or broader village membership system is inferred.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: Direct VIZ setting name; no geographical equivalence or comprehensive setting detail is asserted.

narrative_archetypes.note: VIZ states Naruto's goal may be to become the next Hokage; it is an opening aspiration, not an achievement or fate claim.

canon_status: The only named individual directly described by the selected VIZ English Volume 1 metadata.

supports: Naruto name, troublemaking-child/Ninja-Academy premise, Village Hidden in the Leaves, and next-Hokage aspiration

comparison_cautions: This entry records a fictional child in a ninja-training institution. It neither asserts historical ninja equivalence nor establishes child-soldier deployment, rank, combat ability, chakra/jutsu, clan, family history, or later development.

The product synopsis reports a past fatal village attack but does not say Naruto caused it, is the fox spirit, has a particular relationship to it, or experiences a specified form of bullying/isolation.
No anime, film, game, novel, guidebook, later-manga, Boruto, or outcome material is imported.
